## The RealReal Announces Timing of Its Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call


October 14, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/440516453/files/doc_news/The-RealReal-Announces-Timing-of-Its-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


SAN FRANCISCO


, Oct. 14, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[The RealReal](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795971-1&h=3083765987&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.therealreal.com%2F&a=The+RealReal) (Nasdaq: REAL)—the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods—today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter, ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on October 29, 2026.


The RealReal will host a conference call at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time) to review its financial results.


A live webcast of the conference call will be available online at[investor.therealreal.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795971-1&h=51367227&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.therealreal.com%2F&a=investor.therealreal.com) . The archived webcast will be available shortly after the call at the same location.


To access the live webcast, please register at this link:[https://the-realreal-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795971-1&h=3814369771&u=https%3A%2F%2Fthe-realreal-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fthe-realreal-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net%2F)


**About** **The RealReal Inc.**
The RealReal is the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated resale luxury goods, trusted by a community of 45 million members. Its full-service consignment model across fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art and home, makes it easy for customers to buy and sell luxury wherever they are. The Company combines rigorous, expert-led authentication with AI and proprietary technology to optimize operations and pricing while streamlining the customer experience. Backed by 15 years of proprietary data and more than 50 million items sold, The RealReal has become the preferred destination for modern luxury resale, redefining the luxury lifecycle.
